method: Real pinned Three.js constructors, paint-only canvas stubs, original animate(0) for prescribed states; CPU mesh vertex bounds. No WebGL/render/game test.

coordinateFrame.unit: game world unit; no physical metre claim
coordinateFrame.root: identity except canonical translation; body identity

exclusions: Part.update scale spring, lift, hop and shake
Wires, scenery, cars, boat and cat

sampling.note: Exact transformed geometry vertices at sampled poses; union is NOT a guaranteed continuous swept envelope. Generic Part.update bounce/drag/shake is excluded.

terminalDiagnostics.method: Five points around each attachPoint, parallel rays along negative VIEW_DIR from 20 units toward the body, sampled at 0/.25/.5/.75/1 (one state for static devices). Own opaque art only; excludes terminal itself, plate, wires and scene. Not a perspective screenshot, touch test, or visibility guarantee.
terminalDiagnostics.overlapMeaning: Per-mesh AABB overlap is only a broad-phase warning, NOT proof of triangle intersection.

sampling.meaning: f=wheel angle/(2*pi), 0..1; s=independent sway phase/(2*pi), 0..1; turnV=1.05, time=s*pi, original animate(0). This explores angle/phase combinations, not a single elapsed-time trajectory.
